Priya: Quick update — Legal just added a short EU contractor data-handling annex to the policy library. Effective date: 2026-04-15. Please read it and complete the ~12min microtraining by 2026-04-22.

Marco: link to the annex + training? :pray:

Priya: Internal doc + training links: https://rwd.internals/docs/policies/eu-contractor-data-annex and https://training.redwoodinference.com/learn/eu-contractor-annex (login required).

Aisha: Are contractors considered in the manager attestation requirement or is this just employees?

Priya: Good Q — contractors are included. Managers who own contractor relationships need to attest they've reviewed the annex with their contractors and verified controls. Manager attestation deadline: 2026-04-22.

Tom (HR Bot): New checklist created: /forms/manager-attest-eu-contractors — deadline 2026-04-22. Weekly reminder will be sent to managers.

Signe: Can Legal get a CSV export of the attestation responses for audit purposes?

Tom (HR Bot): CSV export is available to People Ops + Legal. I'll post the export query and permission list in #eng-compliance later today.

Marco: I'll add the training to my team calendar and nudge contractors individually.

Priya: Action items for managers: 1) Read annex. 2) Complete the microtraining yourself. 3) Submit the manager attestation form. 4) Confirm contractors completed training or provide alternative evidence. Example attestation text to paste into the form: ```Manager attestation: I, [Manager name], confirm I have reviewed the EU Contractor Data Annex with the listed contractors and verified that appropriate data-handling controls are in place. Date: YYYY-MM-DD```

Aisha: Can we get a shared tracker so Managers can see who has completed what?

Priya: Yes — People Ops tracking sheet: https://sheets.redwoodinference.com/d/1EuAnnexTrack (view/comment). Managers will receive edit access automatically after form submission; DM me for bulk access.

Signe: Heads-up: Legal asked for copies of signed attestations for vendor onboarding. We'll need to coordinate handoff.

Priya: I'll compile a weekly export and drop it in #legal on Fridays. Escalation flow: if manager attestation not received by 2026-04-22, People Ops will email the manager and cc their director.

Tom (HR Bot): Reminders scheduled: 2026-04-08, 2026-04-15, 2026-04-20.

Marco: Noted, thanks — will follow up with my contractors. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks all — ping me if you hit blockers or need the annex translated for contractor contacts.
